name: ChatBlazer
description_en:
ChatBlazer publishes hosted and separately licensed server software for multi-user chat rooms, with room roles, moderated speaker events, private messages, transcripts and database integration. Its hosted pricing counts simultaneous server connections and audio-video streams, rather than support-agent seats. Developer Edition is a separate protocol-integration offer.

An illustrative moderated event uses audience, moderator and speaker roles, queues questions for approval and restricts access to the intended room. However, the public site mixes ChatBlazer X and XI and contains Flash, old Java and old Windows requirements. Current supported binaries, browser/video compatibility and continued delivery were not established. This is documentation research without installation, login, chat, integration, load test or purchase.
description_zh:
ChatBlazer公布托管及独立服务器许可的多人聊天室软件，包含房间角色、主持嘉宾活动、私信、聊天记录及数据库集成。托管价格按同时服务器连接和音视频流计算，而非客服席位。Developer Edition是独立协议集成方案。

以假设主持活动为例，观众、审核人员与嘉宾分角色，问题排队获批，访问限于目标房间。但公开网站混用ChatBlazer X与XI，并包含Flash、旧Java及旧Windows要求。此次未确定当前受支持安装包、浏览器／视频兼容及持续交付。本稿为文档研究，未安装、登录、聊天、集成、压测或购买。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign room access by group/user and configure global or room-specific roles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按组／用户指定房间访问，并配置全局或按房间角色。

core_features.explanation_en: Moderators can approve and edit audience questions before passing them to a guest speaker.
core_features.explanation_zh: 审核人员可批准并编辑观众问题，再交嘉宾回答。

core_features.explanation_en: Purchased user capacity limits concurrent server connections; extra logins are denied at the limit.
core_features.explanation_zh: 购买用户容量限制同时服务器连接，触顶后拒绝额外登录。

core_features.explanation_en: Published server-license features include existing member databases and optional database-backed chat logs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 公布服务器许可功能包括现有会员数据库及可选数据库聊天记录。

en: Investigate an existing ChatBlazer installation’s room, moderation and license obligations.
Evaluate a controlled speaker event only after obtaining a currently supported client/server demonstration.
zh: 核查现有ChatBlazer部署的房间、审核及许可义务。
获得当前受支持客户端／服务器演示后，再评估受控嘉宾活动。
use_cases.basis: Editorial scenarios; current technical suitability is not established.

Version and runtime uncertainty.en: Pricing refers to XI while FAQ/features describe X, Flash client, Java1.5+ and older Windows service setup. Do not treat those pages as a verified current deployment specification.
Version and runtime uncertainty.zh: 价格页称XI，FAQ／功能页称X、Flash客户端、Java1.5+及旧Windows服务设置，不能将其视为已核实当前部署规范。

steps.en: Obtain exact supported version, client runtime, video stack and a current working demonstration before choosing hosting or server license.
steps.zh: 选择托管或服务器许可前，获取准确支持版本、客户端运行时、视频栈及当前可用演示。

steps.en: Confirm connection and AV capacity, domain rights, room access and moderator permissions.
steps.zh: 确认连接与音视频容量、域名权利、房间访问及审核权限。

steps.en: Test capacity rejection, private-room entry, question approval and log export on supported software.
steps.zh: 在受支持软件上测试容量拒绝、私有房间访问、问题审批及记录导出。

items.name: Relational database logs
items.scope: FAQ lists MS SQL Server,Oracle,MySQL for profiles/logs under server license; supported versions and export portability unknown.

items.name: Developer Edition
items.scope: Separate protocol-level integration for proprietary software/OEM; not proof of open-source redistribution rights.

items.en: The FAQ places audio-video in the Flash client and excludes it from the mobile client; do not infer universal mobile video.
items.zh: FAQ将音视频置于Flash客户端并排除移动客户端，不能推断通用移动视频。

items.en: Unlimited rooms do not remove total concurrent-user or room-specific caps.
items.zh: 房间数不限不取消总并发用户或每房间额度。

items.en: Server maintenance is described as free in year one and20% of license cost annually afterward; without it no patches/upgrades or priority support.
items.zh: 服务器维护描述为首年免费，此后每年许可成本20%；无维护则无补丁／升级或优先支持。

items.en: Published pages mix generations and legacy dependencies. Current availability, security maintenance and interoperability are unresolved.
items.zh: 公布页面混合版本及旧依赖，当前可用性、安全维护及互操作仍不明确。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公布托管每并发用户连接每月$0.50，加每音视频会话容量每月$3；音视频流包含于用户容量，不是另加用户。超过1000用户询价。托管称30天退款保证，不是免费档／试用。Enterprise Server X询价，FAQ称第2年起维护每年20%。X／XI及双倍用户促销未明确。

faq.question_en: Does100 users plus40 AV sessions mean140 concurrent users?
faq.question_zh: 100用户加40音视频会话代表140并发用户吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Pricing says AV sessions are a subset of purchased connections: at most40 of those100 users can stream AV in that example.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。价格页称音视频会话是所购连接的子集，例中100用户最多40位可传音视频。

faq.question_en: Does a server download mean open source?
faq.question_zh: 可下载服务器就代表开源吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The vendor calls its technology proprietary and describes purchased domain/server rights. Full license and current maintenance terms still require confirmation.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。厂商称技术专有，并描述购买域名／服务器权利，完整许可及当前维护条款仍需确认。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.

All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Identify the room software and its publication age
sections.title_zh: 识别聊天室软件及文档年代
sections.en:
ChatBlazer’s public offering is hosted room software or a downloadable Enterprise Server license. Features describe community chat, private messages, user/room groups, speakers, moderation, file/media tools and transcripts. It is not evidence of a complete modern customer-service ticketing workflow, even though the FAQ describes representatives opening separate customer chat windows.

The site is reachable over ordinary HTTPS, but its footer shows2022, pricing mentions XI and most feature/FAQ explanations describe X. References to Flash Player8, Java1.5 and Windows NT/2000 indicate that the read operational descriptions are from an older stack. A reachable page does not verify an actively maintained release. Obtain current support documentation and a working demonstration before making a new deployment decision. No old runtime was installed for this research.
sections.zh:
ChatBlazer公开方案是托管聊天室或可下载Enterprise Server许可。功能描述社区聊天、私信、用户／房间组、嘉宾、审核、文件／媒体工具及记录。即使FAQ描述客服为不同客户打开聊天窗口，也不能证明完整现代服务工单流程。

网站可通过普通HTTPS访问，但页脚显示2022，价格提XI，多数功能／FAQ描述X。Flash Player8、Java1.5及Windows NT／2000说明所读操作描述属于较旧技术栈。页面可访问不证明版本持续维护。新部署前应取得当前支持文档及可用演示，此次未安装旧运行时。

sections.title_en: Use roles to model a controlled event
sections.en:
For a hypothetical guest interview, define audience, moderator and guest-speaker roles. The FAQ says participants can raise hands, moderators can approve and edit incoming questions and then pass them to the speaker. Room entry can be restricted by group, individual assignment, password, invisible listing, type or schedule. Global and room-specific roles are described separately.

Those controls need testing with separate identities: verify an uninvited viewer cannot enter, an audience member cannot publish as a speaker and an edited question is the one actually delivered. An invisible room alone should not be treated as a proven authorization boundary. The published list includes kicking, banning, flood control and profanity filters, but current auditability, restoration after removal and failure behavior were not established.
sections.zh:
以假设嘉宾访谈为例，设置观众、审核人员及嘉宾角色。FAQ称参与者可举手，审核人员批准并编辑问题后交嘉宾。房间可按组、个人分配、密码、隐藏列表、用户类型或时间表限制访问，全局与房间角色分别描述。

这些控制需以不同身份测试：验证未受邀观众不能进入、观众不能作为嘉宾发布，且实际送达的是编辑后问题。隐藏房间本身不能当作已证明授权边界。功能表列踢出、封禁、防刷及脏话过滤，但当前可审计性、删除后恢复及失败行为未确定。

sections.title_en: Count connections before adding AV capacity
sections.title_zh: 加音视频容量前先计算连接
sections.en:
The pricing page defines a user as a server connection, so100 users means100 concurrent connections. It lists$0.50 per connection/month plus$3 per AV session/month. The AV allowance is inside the connection cap:100 users and40 AV sessions means up to40 of those100 users can stream, not140 concurrent users. Unlimited rooms do not remove that overall limit; the FAQ says additional logins are rejected when capacity is reached.

Pricing also displays a free-double-user promotion without sufficient mechanics to calculate checkout. Minimum purchasable capacity, current currency code, promotion duration and exact billing application remain unresolved. The FAQ describes mobile AV exclusion and an additional streaming server for licensed video deployments, listing Adobe FMS,Red5 or Wowza. These are historical prerequisites, not a tested current video specification or an included software entitlement. Confirm supported clients, bandwidth and streaming-license costs separately.
sections.zh:
价格页将用户定义为服务器连接，100用户即100并发连接。列每连接每月$0.50，加每音视频会话每月$3。音视频额度包含于连接上限：100用户与40音视频会话，最多其中40人传流，并非140并发。房间数不限不取消总额度，FAQ称触顶后拒绝额外登录。

价格另展示免费双倍用户促销，但机制不足以计算结账。最低可购容量、币种代码、促销期限及准确计费应用仍不明。FAQ排除移动音视频，并为许可视频部署描述额外流服务器，列Adobe FMS、Red5或Wowza。这些是历史前提，并非已测当前视频规范或包含的软件权益。需另确认受支持客户端、带宽和流媒体许可成本。

sections.title_en: Separate hosting from operating your own server
sections.title_zh: 区分托管与自行运营服务器
sections.en:
For hosting, the FAQ describes fulfilment credentials, a code generator, administration, configuration, logs and a user guide. A server-license buyer instead receives downloadable files and operates the server, with a separate video stack when needed. The FAQ discusses relational member databases and storing logs in MS SQL Server,Oracle or MySQL, but provides no verified current version matrix or migration procedure in the pages read.

The vendor calls the technology proprietary. Published domain rights are also narrower than unlimited room creation: the FAQ says each license covers a single domain, with additional site/domain licenses available. Developer Edition advertises protocol-level embedding into proprietary applications but does not establish redistribution rights, a current SDK or API authentication. SSO language does not prove compatibility with a specific modern identity provider.
sections.zh:
托管方面，FAQ描述交付登录资料、代码生成器、管理、配置、记录及指南。服务器许可购买者则收下载文件并自运服务器，需要视频时另有流媒体栈。FAQ讨论会员关系数据库及MS SQL Server、Oracle或MySQL记录存储，但所读页面未给已核实当前版本矩阵或迁移程序。

厂商称技术专有。域名权利也比不限房间窄：FAQ称每许可覆盖单域名，可另购网站／域名许可。Developer Edition宣传协议级嵌入专有应用，但不确定再分发权、当前SDK或API认证。SSO措辞不能证明兼容特定现代身份提供商。

sections.title_en: Treat published prices as an offer requiring current confirmation
sections.title_zh: 将公布价格视为需当前确认的方案
sections.en:
The hosting page advertises a thirty-day money-back guarantee and directs people seeking a free service to a separate321Chat site. That is not a sustained-free ChatBlazer tier or evidence that321Chat is the same product. Enterprise Server is quoted. Server maintenance/support is described as included for year one, then20% of the server-license cost annually; without it the FAQ excludes patches, upgrades and priority support. Major-version discounts are distinct from free minor updates.

Before purchase, obtain the actual version, domain allowance, concurrency model, refund conditions, maintenance renewal and supported operating stack. The site’s internal performance claims and past customer labels were not independently validated. Complete license text, current security maintenance, log portability, backups, restore and termination retrieval remain unknown. An existing-license investigation is more defensible from these sources than a claim of proven current production readiness.
sections.zh:
托管页宣传30天退款保证，并把寻找免费服务的人引向独立321Chat网站。这不是持续免费ChatBlazer档，也不证明321Chat是同一产品。Enterprise Server需询价。服务器维护／支持描述为首年包含，此后每年服务器许可成本20%；无维护时FAQ排除补丁、升级及优先支持。大版本优惠与免费小更新不同。

购买前应取得实际版本、域名额度、并发模型、退款条件、维护续约及支持技术栈。网站内部性能主张及历史客户标签未独立验证。完整许可、当前安全维护、记录可迁移性、备份、恢复及终止取回仍未知。这些来源更能支持现有许可核查，而不足以宣称已证明当前生产就绪。
